window.reading: A giant — Spotify, Believe, Chartmetric — can extend its offer toward consolidation. The only answer has two parts: speed of execution, and France-first depth. This is a reading, not a measurement.

pitch.quote: An independent artist in France juggles six tools without ever seeing their career whole: stats on one side, an expense spreadsheet on the other, SACEM paying 18 months late, URSSAF as a quarterly panic. From Day 1 brings it all together — multi-DSP analytics, consolidated revenue, reconciled French rights, AI royalty audit, real-time catalog valuation. Chartmetric does stats. Stem does splits. Songtrust does publishing. Nobody does all of it, and nobody will do it in France without rebuilding compliance first. From {low} to {high} per month, from bedroom producer to indie label.
